cards.text_zh: 先精确定义计数对象及有序性、重复和对称；再选择分类、递推、双计数、容斥或生成函数，并用最小规模实例核对。
cards.text_en: Define the counted objects, order, repetition, and symmetry before choosing cases, recurrence, double counting, inclusion-exclusion, or generating functions; check the smallest legal instances.

cards.text_zh: 图论题先确认简单性、方向、连通性和计数对象；区分路径与游走，使用度数和、树结构、矩阵树定理或平面图公式时逐项核对前提。
cards.text_en: Check simplicity, orientation, connectivity, and the counted object; distinguish paths from walks and verify every hypothesis of degree, tree, matrix-tree, or planar formulas.

cards.text_zh: 数值方法题必须写出题目指定的公式、代入给定初值并保留精度；用残差、误差阶、区间包含或稳定性条件独立核验，而不能只给最终根。
cards.text_en: State the requested numerical formula, substitute the supplied initial data, and respect precision; verify with a residual, error order, enclosing interval, or stability condition rather than reporting only a root.

cards.text_zh: 交换极限与积分前应明确使用单调收敛、Fatou 引理或支配收敛，并逐一核对非负性、单调性、几乎处处收敛和可积支配函数等对应前提。
cards.text_en: Before interchanging limits and integrals, name the monotone, Fatou, or dominated convergence result and verify its corresponding nonnegativity, monotonicity, almost-everywhere convergence, and integrable domination hypotheses.

cards.text_zh: 先检查参数正则性、维数和法向取向，再由基本形式或协变导数计算几何量；最后检查结果在允许的重新参数化或取向变化下应如何变换。
cards.text_en: Check regularity, dimension, and orientation before computing from fundamental forms or covariant derivatives; then verify the expected behavior under reparametrization or orientation reversal.

cards.text_zh: 明确样本空间与是否等可能，区分独立和互斥；优先使用条件化、全概率或指示变量，并检查概率在 [0,1]、总质量为 1。
cards.text_en: Specify the sample space and whether outcomes are equiprobable, distinguish independence from disjointness, use conditioning or indicators, and check total mass and the range [0,1].

cards.text_zh: 从定义、同态核像、阶数和商结构出发；使用同构定理、域塔或多项式不可约性时必须明确对象、基域和每个假设。
cards.text_en: Start from definitions, kernels, images, orders, and quotients; state the objects, base field, and every hypothesis when using isomorphism theorems, field towers, or irreducibility.

cards.text_zh: 写清状态、时间方向、过滤与条件信息；利用 Markov 性、独立增量、停时或鞅性质后，检查初值、归一化和极限条件。
cards.text_en: State the state, time direction, filtration, and conditioning information; after using Markov, independent-increment, stopping-time, or martingale properties, check initial values, normalization, and limit conditions.

cards.text_zh: 先定位奇点、零点、区域和围道方向，再选择局部展开、留数、最大模、辐角原理或解析延拓；检查边界与定理作用域。
cards.text_en: Locate singularities, zeros, the domain, and contour orientation before choosing local expansions, residues, maximum modulus, argument principle, or analytic continuation; check theorem scope and boundaries.

cards.text_zh: 先识别方程类型并求通解，再施加初值或边值；最终通过求导代回原方程并检查最大存在区间。
cards.text_en: Identify the equation class and obtain the general solution before imposing initial or boundary data; differentiate and substitute into the original equation and check the maximal interval.

cards.text_zh: 写出抽样模型、参数空间和统计量分布；估计与检验分别核对偏差、方差、枢轴量、显著性水平及备择方向。
cards.text_en: State the sampling model, parameter space, and statistic distribution; check bias, variance, pivots, significance level, and alternative direction for estimation and testing.

cards.text_zh: 区分范数、弱与弱星拓扑；使用开映射、闭图像、一致有界或 Riesz 表示前，逐项核对完备性、线性和有界性。
cards.text_en: Distinguish norm, weak, and weak-star topologies; verify completeness, linearity, and boundedness before using open mapping, closed graph, uniform boundedness, or Riesz representation.

cards.text_zh: 先写设计矩阵、误差假设和目标参数；区分系数无偏性、效率、标准误与检验有效性，并按协方差结构选择 OLS、GLS 或稳健方差。
cards.text_en: State the design matrix, error assumptions, and target parameter; distinguish coefficient bias, efficiency, standard errors, and test validity, choosing OLS, GLS, or robust covariance as warranted.

cards.text_zh: 先确认 PDE 类型、区域、初边值和解的正则性，再选择分离变量、特征线、能量法、最大值原理或弱形式；最后代回并检查边界。
cards.text_en: Identify PDE type, domain, initial-boundary data, and solution regularity before choosing separation, characteristics, energy, maximum principles, or weak forms; substitute back and check the boundary.

cards.text_zh: 按目标选择消元、行列式、特征多项式或标准形；用迹、行列式、秩和维数关系交叉核对重数与维数。
cards.text_en: Choose elimination, determinants, characteristic polynomials, or normal forms according to the target; cross-check multiplicities and dimensions with trace, determinant, rank, and dimension identities.

cards.text_zh: 先写可行域和目标，再给出最优性证书：凸性与 KKT、原对偶可行解、交换论证或动态规划；同时验证可达性。
cards.text_en: State the feasible set and objective, then provide an optimality certificate through convexity and KKT, primal-dual feasible solutions, an exchange argument, or dynamic programming; verify attainability.

cards.text_zh: 明确点态、一致、几乎处处或范数收敛以及量词顺序；交换极限、积分和导数前必须给出适用条件，并检查端点。
cards.text_en: Specify pointwise, uniform, almost-everywhere, or norm convergence and the quantifier order; justify interchanging limits, integrals, and derivatives and check endpoints.

cards.text_zh: 先按当前空间定义开集、闭包、紧致或连通；只在附加条件成立时使用度量空间、Hausdorff 或欧氏空间中的等价刻画。
cards.text_en: Use the definitions of openness, closure, compactness, or connectedness in the stated space; use metric, Hausdorff, or Euclidean equivalences only under their extra hypotheses.

cards.text_zh: 先分解并按素因子或赋值分析必要条件，再用构造、下降或同余证明充分性；所有整数候选必须代回且证明穷尽。
cards.text_en: Factor and derive local prime or valuation conditions, then prove sufficiency by construction, descent, or congruences; substitute every integer candidate and prove exhaustiveness.

cards.text_zh: 主动检查最小合法实例、端点、退化情形、等号情形以及题目排除的值。
cards.text_en: Test the smallest legal instance, endpoints, degeneracies, equality cases, and every excluded value.

cards.text_zh: 核对关键引理的全部前提，并尝试用边界例、反例或逆命题否证结论；区分必要条件和充分条件。
cards.text_en: Check every hypothesis of the decisive lemma and try to falsify the claim with boundary cases, counterexamples, or the converse; distinguish necessity from sufficiency.

cards.text_zh: 逐项判断每个选项的真伪，最后重新核对题目问的是正确项还是错误项，以及单选或多选。
cards.text_en: Evaluate every option, then recheck whether the question asks for true or false options and whether one or several labels are required.

cards.text_zh: 提交前逐项核对所求公式、数值、全部对象、单位、定义域、精度和必要论证是否均已出现。
cards.text_en: Before submission, check that every requested formula, value, object, unit, domain, precision requirement, and necessary justification is present.

cards.text_zh: 计数前先固定有序性与等价关系。容斥要写清各交集，生成函数要核对系数对象，Burnside 计数要逐类计算固定点并除以群阶；最后检查无对称或最小规模情形。
cards.text_en: Fix order and equivalence first. For inclusion-exclusion list intersections, for generating functions identify coefficients, and for Burnside count fixed points by conjugacy type and divide by the group order; check the smallest cases.

cards.text_zh: 图论结论应配套证书：生成树用 Laplace 余子式，匹配核对 Hall 条件，平面图同时核对连通性与面数，极值结论给出达到等号的图；小图可直接枚举复核。
cards.text_en: Attach a certificate: a Laplacian cofactor for spanning trees, Hall conditions for matchings, connectivity and face counts for planar identities, and an attaining graph for extrema; enumerate small graphs when feasible.

cards.text_zh: 先写迭代映射和起点，再逐步代入；结论必须同时核对原方程残差、停止准则和收敛前提。Newton 法检查导数非零及吸引域，二分法检查端点异号和区间保持。
cards.text_en: State the iteration map and starting value, then substitute step by step. Check the original residual, stopping rule, and convergence hypotheses; for Newton verify a nonzero derivative and attraction, and for bisection preserve a sign-changing bracket.

cards.text_zh: 数值求积须分别给出节点、权重、代数精度和误差符号约定。先用低次单项式核对精度，再用余项公式或精确积分减求积值复核误差。
cards.text_en: Give nodes, weights, degree of exactness, and the error sign convention separately. Check low-degree monomials, then verify the error by a remainder formula or exact integral minus quadrature value.

cards.text_zh: 支配收敛只能在逐点几乎处处收敛且存在同一个可积控制函数时交换极限与积分；必须明确控制函数与参数无关，并检查积分空间和测度。
cards.text_en: Dominated convergence permits interchange only with almost-everywhere pointwise convergence and one parameter-independent integrable dominator; identify the measure space and verify domination explicitly.

cards.text_zh: Tonelli 适用于非负可测函数，Fubini 需要绝对可积；交换积分次序前必须先验证对应条件，不能从某个迭代积分有限反推绝对可积。
cards.text_en: Tonelli applies to nonnegative measurable functions, whereas Fubini requires absolute integrability. Verify the appropriate hypothesis before changing order; one finite iterated integral alone is insufficient.

cards.text_zh: 先写清收敛模式及测度空间是否有限，再使用蕴含关系；涉及 L1 收敛时检查范数，涉及期望极限时优先检查一致可积性，并主动寻找移动尖峰反例。
cards.text_en: State the convergence mode and whether the measure space is finite before using implications. Check norms for L1 convergence and uniform integrability for expectation limits; test moving-spike counterexamples.

cards.text_zh: 参数曲面先算 X_u、X_v 并确认 EG-F^2>0；再统一法向计算第二基本形式。Gauss 曲率应核对 K=(LN-M^2)/(EG-F^2)，并检查换法向不改变 K。
cards.text_en: Compute X_u and X_v and verify EG-F^2>0 before fixing one normal for the second form. Check K=(LN-M^2)/(EG-F^2), which must be unchanged by reversing the normal.

cards.text_zh: 使用 Gauss-Bonnet 时必须明确曲面取向、边界方向、测地曲率符号、角点外角以及 Euler 示性数；有边界和无边界公式不能混用。
cards.text_en: For Gauss-Bonnet specify orientation, induced boundary direction, geodesic-curvature sign, corner exterior angles, and Euler characteristic; do not mix closed and boundary formulas.

cards.text_zh: 分布计算先确定支持集，再做变量变换并带 Jacobian；次序统计量可从联合密度或生存函数推导。最终检查密度非负、积分为 1，概率和期望满足边界情形。
cards.text_en: Determine support before applying a change of variables with its Jacobian; derive order statistics from joint densities or survival functions. Check nonnegativity, total mass one, and boundary cases for probabilities and expectations.

cards.text_zh: 首达概率写一步分析方程和全部边界值，期望首达时间写对应 Poisson 方程；平稳分布检查非负、总和 1 及 pi P=pi，并区分平稳性与极限分布。
cards.text_en: For hitting probabilities write first-step equations and every boundary value; for mean hitting times use the corresponding Poisson equation. Check nonnegativity, normalization, and pi P=pi, distinguishing stationarity from limiting behavior.

cards.text_zh: 群论结构题先用阶数、Lagrange 与 Sylow 数目限制候选，再检查正规性、作用核与轨道稳定子；给出同构类型时必须同时证明存在性和排他性。
cards.text_en: Use orders, Lagrange, and Sylow-number constraints before checking normality, action kernels, and orbit-stabilizer. An isomorphism classification needs both existence and exclusion of alternatives.

cards.text_zh: 环与域题要写明基环或基域。商环先核对理想，扩张次数用塔式公式，最小多项式需同时证明消去性与不可约性；有限维数和商结构应互相校验。
cards.text_en: State the base ring or field. Verify idealhood before quotients, use the tower law for degrees, and prove both annihilation and irreducibility for a minimal polynomial; cross-check dimensions and quotient structure.

cards.text_zh: 把证明压缩为“假设 -> 引理前提 -> 引理结论 -> 目标”的链条；任何未验证箭头都视为风险。分别尝试否定结论、逆命题和边界情形，防止把必要条件当充分条件。
cards.text_en: Compress the proof into assumptions -> lemma hypotheses -> lemma conclusion -> target. Treat every unchecked arrow as a risk, and test negation, converse, and boundary cases to avoid confusing necessity with sufficiency.

cards.text_zh: 把近似值代回原问题计算残差；把格式精度与数学误差分开。声称 p 阶时检查最低未消失项，声称稳定时检查给定步长对应的放大因子。
cards.text_en: Substitute the approximation into the original problem and compute a residual, separating display precision from mathematical error. Verify the first nonzero error term for order p and the amplification factor for stability.

cards.text_zh: 计数答案必须是非负整数；递推检查初值和索引偏移。用最小两个合法规模直接枚举，检查是否错误除以对称因子或遗漏退化对象。
cards.text_en: A count must be a nonnegative integer; verify recurrence initial values and index shifts. Enumerate the two smallest legal sizes to catch incorrect symmetry division or omitted degeneracies.

cards.text_zh: 概率须在 [0,1]，密度或质量函数总量为 1；期望应落在变量支持集的凸包内。把参数取到确定事件、空事件或退化分布处检查公式极限。
cards.text_en: Probabilities lie in [0,1], densities and masses normalize to one, and expectations lie in the convex hull of the support. Test deterministic, impossible, and degenerate parameter limits.

cards.text_zh: 同构或标准形结论要核对阶、维数、秩、指数、扭结部分和生成元关系等不变量；矩阵结论用迹、行列式和特征多项式交叉检查。
cards.text_en: Check order, dimension, rank, exponent, torsion, and generator relations for isomorphism or normal-form claims; cross-check matrix claims with trace, determinant, and characteristic polynomial.
